summary:
The backend side of this contract is already in place and spelled exactly as the contract requires, so I made no changes.

- `src/CleanArchitecture.Api/Controllers/HealthController.cs` — `[Route("api/health")]`, `[AllowAnonymous]`, `GET` returning `200 {"status":"ok"}` (camelCase serialization), following the `api/tutorials` route convention and the `ApiController` base.
- `src/CleanArchitecture.Contracts/Common/HealthResponse.cs` — `record HealthResponse(string Status)`.
- An integration test for it already exists under `tests/`.

The requested change — a loading indicator while the health check is in progress, keeping green for `ok` and red otherwise — is view state in the Angular footer (`app.component.ts/html/css`), not something a .NET API can express; inventing an extra field for it would add contract the other side did not ask for. Applied the recorded project rule that backend health is surfaced only as `{"status":"ok"}` at `GET /api/health` and the footer renders the raw value.
